page_title: LEV 0-3 RAY | Levante v Rayo Vallecano 19/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Miguel Sesma has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' A corner kick by Levante is thwarted by the well prepared Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano).
90+5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Levante, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+4' Miguel Sesma has issued a yellow card to Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano).
90+4' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano).
90+3' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90+1' Carlos Espi (Levante) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Ivan Romero (Levante) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide.
85' Manu Sanchez (Levante) sends a chip pass into the box, but Augusto Batalla is quickest to intercept the ball.
84' Ivan Romero (Levante) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post!
83' Goduine Koyalipou (Levante) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Augusto Batalla pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
82' Julian Calero has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jose Morales (Levante) replacing Matias Moreno.
82' The substitution is prepared. Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nobel Mendy.
81' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
78' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Mathew Ryan, who makes a comfortable save.
75' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Jorge de Frutos is replaced by Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano).
74' Substitution. Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) has come on for Fran Perez.
74' Substitution. Goduine Koyalipou (Levante) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Etta Eyong walks off.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Unai Vencedor trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante).
74' Julian Calero decides to make a substitution. Roger Brugue will be replaced by Carlos Espi (Levante).
74' The game has come to an end for Carlos Alvarez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante).
73' Augusto Batalla makes a brilliant save! Etta Eyong (Levante) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper low into the middle of the goal.
69' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
68' Matias Moreno (Levante) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
65' 0 - 3 Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot inside the right post.
64' Rough tackle by Kervin Arriaga (Levante). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Inigo Perez has decided to substitute Alemao and he is replaced by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Unai Lopez.
61' Unai Vencedor (Levante) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
60' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

60' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Rayo Vallecano are going to take it.
59' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
58' The resulting corner from Carlos Alvarez (Levante) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger. Good work from Levante as they win a corner.
54' Manu Sanchez (Levante) sends a long ball in, but Augusto Batalla comfortably gathers the ball.
53' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Miguel Sesma blows his whistle for a foul. Levante are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
53' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) is able to continue to play.
53' The game is interrupted now, Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
52' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the right post.
51' The attendance is 20312.

51' Roger Brugue (Levante) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the middle of the target, but Augusto Batalla pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
50' Manu Sanchez (Levante) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
50' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Levante are awarded a corner kick.
49' Etta Eyong (Levante) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
48' Ivan Romero (Levante) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
47' Miguel Sesma blows the whistle, Manu Sanchez (Levante) is penalised for a foul.
47' Manu Sanchez (Levante) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' Miguel Sesma blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:2.
45+2' Miguel Sesma blows his whistle. Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul after dangerous play.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' The Levante players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
41' The resulting corner from Carlos Alvarez (Levante) is cleared by the defence.
40' Etta Eyong (Levante) gets inside the box and tries to beat Augusto Batalla with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
38' Poor challenge! Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for tripping and Miguel Sesma blows his whistle.
34' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
33' The corner is swung in but Levante can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Levante.
31' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Miguel Sesma has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
30' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Levante.
29' Etta Eyong (Levante) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Levante force a corner. They send men into the box.
25' 0 - 2 Goal! Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.
23' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
23' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
22' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Rayo Vallecano.
20' PENALTY APPEAL by Levante, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
17' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Manu Sanchez (Levante) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
15' The goal by Levante is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
15' The Levante players halt their celebrations as referee Miguel Sesma makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
14' It's a goal! Carlos Alvarez (Levante) converts his effort.
12' 0 - 1 Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is first to latch on to a cross from the resulting corner and he buries the ball clinically into the bottom right corner.
12' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Rayo Vallecano.

11' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a corner kick.
10' Matias Moreno (Levante) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
6' A cross into the box from Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared.
6' Rayo Vallecano are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Unai Vencedor (Levante) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Sesma blows his whistle for a foul.
